media.title: My Heart Is Singing — Deanna Durbin, listening reference
media.description: Digital reissue of Deanna Durbin singing “My Heart Is Singing”, on the Fantastic Voyage album of that title, released in 2008. The song is associated with Three Smart Girls (1936); the release metadata does not establish a particular soundtrack extraction.
